text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes and sent you the list in our DM:

1. #PD-4492, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md, 5 Oct 2025). This was the Eau Claire gatehouse kiosk not sending SMS bay assignments to drivers at Dock Doors 14–18 on the 04:00 shift. It was patched on 4 Oct 2025. The note also lists a follow-up to archive the kiosk logs before the 14 Oct 2025 maintenance window.

2. #4419, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). This was the gatehouse barcode scanners not reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift, and it was escalated to tier-2. The note has no date, so I can't tell how current it is.

None of Moss's other notes has a QFL ticket. The two Central digests list #4409, #4412 and FR-882, but those are for the Marrow accounts, not QFL. The cheat sheet also warns not to mix QFL up with Quarendon Freightways, a different company that isn't a customer.

Outside Moss's notes, I found two more QFL tickets you might want in the weekly notes:
- #4912, listed as open on the QFL account profile (updated 2026-09-30).
- #8841, in your own 9 Apr 2026 renewal debrief notes.
